description: Hand-checked mapping from company_name / company_number in the crosswalk to a display group. Every company not listed here is Independent. A mapped group that resolves to exactly one distillery is Independent by definition. Do not add a parent you cannot state from the register row.

groups.note: Diageo plc (00023307) and its Scottish operating subsidiary Diageo Scotland Limited (SC000750, SIC 11010). Name variants of the same group, not a guess at ultimate ownership of other companies.
